text:
priya: Quick sync  sketched a draft for a 'Reserved Throughput' add-on customers can buy to reserve throughput per route. Sales asked for per-route reservations, burst credits, and an SLA. Need launch criteria and gating. thoughts?

ben: +1. Need clear pricing bands and a non-linear discount for annual commit. Also define failure/fallback behavior when reserved capacity is exhausted.

elaine: Suggest gating on observability (per-route latency/err dashboards), billing shape (min 3-month commit), and infra readiness (autoscaler for reserved pools).

samir: Ops note  per-route reservations increase routing complexity. Routing policy should be: reserved pool -> shared pool -> fallback variant. We'll need reservation_id tags for tracing/accounting.

jess: From product  draft launch criteria: 1) contract template approved by legal; 2) Benchmarks: p95 latency under target at reserved load; 3) Billing integration + usage preview in console; 4) Sales playbook + runbook. I'll enumerate metrics.

legal-bot: @jess draft term suggestion: "Reserved Throughput" includes SLA carveouts for maintenance and force majeure. Sales must not promise unlimited burst beyond committed caps.

sales-ops: Customer asks: ability to shift reserved capacity between routes weekly. Also they want 'burst credits' that auto-replenish monthly. Need to confirm cooldown and migration rules.

ben: On burst credits  implement as a prefunded token bucket per contract. If tokens are exhausted, requests fall back to best-effort and are metered. Keep accounting simple: tokens represent billing units (e.g., 1 token = 1k tokens).

priya: Quick config sketch for UI/API. Thoughts? ```json
{
  "addon": "reserved_throughput",
  "routes": [{"id": "chat.generate","reserved_rps": 50}],
  "burst_tokens_per_month": 1000000
}
```

samir: Looks good. Implementation notes: routing rule change + metric tags (reservation_id). Timeline estimate: prototype 2 sprints, internal pilot 3rd sprint, GA after pilot + billing/legal sign-off.

elaine: Dependencies: billing APIs for monthly token deduction, console UI for route mapping, legal sign-off, partner comms. I'll compile owners and blockers.

jess: Can we offer a lighter 'starter' SKU for SMBs: smaller reserved slots, no long contract? Market has asked for lower-friction option.

ben: Starter is OK but we should explicitly mark it No-SLA. Naming idea: "Reserved — Starter" vs "Reserved — Committed".

priya: Next steps: owners: eng-platform @samir, billing @ben, product @jess, sales @sales-ops, legal @legal-bot. I'll assemble a decision doc and circulate. Ping me with objections. :white_check_mark:

ops-bot: deploy-preview created for reserved-throughput feature branch (ci/1234).

priya: Thanks  scheduling a 30m sync tomorrow to finalize launch checklist.
